summary: Burke & Herbert Financial Services Corp. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of fixed-to-floating rate subordinated notes due 2036, a routine bank capital issuance rather than a special situation. Pricing terms are blank in this preliminary filing: coupon, principal amount, and spread remain unspecified. Interest is fixed until 2031, then floats at Three-Month Term SOFR plus an unstated spread, paid quarterly. The notes are unsecured, subordinated, rank junior to senior debt and structurally junior to bank subsidiary liabilities, and are callable in 2031 subject to Federal Reserve approval. Watch for final pricing and use of proceeds for capital ratios.
